name: Starlight Bamboo Cathedral Beneath an Aurora Sky
description: An immense bamboo cathedral towering through a forest canopy, its interior illuminated by shimmering starlight, while the night sky above bursts with an aurora borealis, dancing green and purple ribbons.
prompt: Enormous bamboo cathedral stretching skyward, intricate latticed bamboo ribs, interior filled with soft starlight and glowing firefly-like specks, outside the night sky filled with vibrant aurora borealis in greens and purples, mist swirling around base, ethereal fantasy, ultra-detailed, night scene.
caption: Walk beneath a bamboo cathedral bathed in starlight and aurora magic 🌌🍃 Let the northern lights paint your steps.
